ROUTE: Dunlin-235B
REASON: I picked Dunlin because this is a clean, single-answer quantitative reasoning task, and Dunlin leads Willet across every benchmark (MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 75.9, GPQA 64.1 vs 56.2) and internal eval category. Neither model's self-reported task preferences are relevant to a straightforward math question, so I defaulted to the higher-capability model.
